claim: With On-demand Advantage mode, launched on Nov 4, 2025, the price of extended retention decreases by 77%, from $0.10/GB-month to $0.023/GB-month.

qualifiers.scope: per GB-month of extended retention, On-demand Advantage

evidence.quote: On-demand Advantage offers data usage with 60% lower pricing compared to On-demand Standard, with data ingest at $0.032/GB and data retrieval at $0.016/GB in the US East (N. Virginia) region. The price of Enhanced fan-out data retrieval is the same as shared-throughput retrievals, making higher fan-out use cases more cost effective. The mode also decreases the price of extended retention by 77% from $0.10/GB-month to $0.023/GB-month.

evidence.heading: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams launches On-demand Advantage mode
